findings.reason: it names the owner (`reckon/crew/promotion.py`) to extend, converting §8 from a parallel literal into one shared constant the promotion site imports.
findings.text: the plan's §8 normalises promotion's landing comments by a new constant `RUN_COMMENT_PREFIX = "c-run-"`, but `reckon/crew/promotion.py:7277` owns `_LANDING_COMMENT_PREFIX = "c-run-"` and `reckon/crew/promotion.py:3635` writes the literal `f"c-run-{run_id}"`; a third spelling of the same string cannot be kept in step, so a change to the landing-comment id would silently stop the fingerprint normalising it and re-review every plan again

findings.reason: it would add a public `plan_review` accessor for the sidecar/report paths to the §4 build scope, so the composer does not depend on a private name to reach a module it already depends on.
findings.text: the composer reaches into `plan_review._REVIEW_SIDECAR_NAME` (and composes `directory / _REVIEW_SIDECAR_NAME`) rather than calling a public accessor, so the sidecar path shape is owned privately by one module and reconstructed by another; the §6 landing already recorded this as an open follow-on

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — `reckon/crew/plan_review.py` (953 lines) hides the record shape, the version/blob keying with the `.at-<blob8>` sibling, the fingerprint normalisation and the recurrence count behind a small interface (`plan_fingerprint`, `store_plan_review`, `read_plan_review`, `list_plan_reviews`, `record_response`, `declined_recurrence`).
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan declares `RUN_COMMENT_PREFIX = "c-run-"` in a second module for a prefix the promotion machinery already owns and writes.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanism it extends on every axis: the review store (`plan_review.py` imports `_review_store.review_store_root`, `write_json_atomically`), the reflex sweep (`_sweep_review_tier` in `reckon/crew/recovery.py`), the dispatch gate (`require_plan_reviewed` sits beside `require_plan_section_visible` in `reckon/crew/routing.py`), and the prompt loaders (`load_plan_review_prompt`/`load_plan_design_review_prompt` sit beside `load_review_prompt` in `reckon/crew/review.py`), and the design brief `c-20260925T1210-design-brief` carries 39 file/function citations.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the plan-review composer in `reckon/crew/recovery.py` composes the report sidecar path itself out of `plan_review._REVIEW_SIDECAR_NAME`, a private constant it opens the module to reach.
